response.title: Should I get a 100 inch or 120 inch screen for a living room where the couch is 10 feet away and the ceiling is 8 feet?
response.answer:
I'd recommend the 120-inch screen for your living room, assuming you're watching 4K content and have enough wall space. At a 10-foot viewing distance, 120 inches provides a cinematic experience without being excessively large for most people.

My recommendation

Choose 120 inches if you primarily watch movies, sports, or play immersive games, and want a theater-like experience.

Choose 100 inches if you mostly watch everyday TV, YouTube, news, or prefer a less visually dominant screen.

At 10 feet, 100 inches is already close to a 40° cinematic field of view, while 120 inches is more immersive at roughly 47°.
